author: Salem Techsperts
description:
NZXT Player One - https://nzxt.co/4xpNi0r

It's insane that a pre-built costs less than the parts inside of it, but here we are.

MY VERDICT: It's a good 1080p Ultra beginner PC if you absolutely don't want to build one yourself, and you want a 2 year umbrella warranty that covers everything. Temps are great, it's easy to service, and has good build quality w/ attention to detail. Just save up your money and eventually upgrade the GPU and PSU in a few years.
